First pre-release of 2.2 — **tidier Bookends and Bookshelf pages** in the KOReader workbench, and a new **sleep screen patch**.

## New

- **Tabs** on the Bookends and Bookshelf pages instead of one long list of sections. Bookends: *Lines*, *Progress bars*, *Preset* (the preset and the on/off switch stay above the tabs). Bookshelf: *Appearance*, *Home*, *Navigation*, *Layout*, *All*. A red dot marks every tab with unsaved changes; Bookbench remembers the tab.
- **Bookends positions as a small page**: click one of the six positions to edit just that one. Each button shows the first line of its position.
- Labels as in Bookends: **Extra top/bottom/left/right margin** (moves only this position, not the whole header or footer); the per-line offset is now called **Move line**.
- **New patch `2-bookbench-screensaver.lua`**: on a sleep screen with a picture and a message, KOReader lays the message over the picture. With the patch, the picture moves into the free space next to the message, so no part of the cover is hidden. Optionally keep the picture centred (smaller). Switch it on the workbench page *Sleep screen*, or copy the file attached to this release into `koreader/patches/` on your e-reader.

## Install

- **Linux:** *Help > Check for updates* in an installed copy (with *Settings > Updates > Include pre-releases* on), or `install.sh` from this repository.
- **Windows:** `Bookbench_Setup_2.2-beta1.exe` (not signed yet: SmartScreen > *More info* > *Run anyway*).
